unchanged_original_rule.description: Default SPY. Fit XLE log returns on SPY and availability-stamped Brent with nonnegative slopes and free intercept on prior252 before last20. At z<=-2 command 100% XLE at next NAV; freeze fit, exit z>=0 or after20 holding intervals.

math.training_return_positions: i-271 through i-20 inclusive (252); first possible i=272 after273levels
math.fit: Centered two-feature active-subset nonnegative least squares with free intercept; full centered rank2 required. Subsets (), (0), (1), (0,1); reject slopes<-1e-12; cliptinyneg to0; SSE tie tolerance32*eps*max(1,SSE,bestSSE), earlier subset retained.
math.sigma: Sample residualSD ddof1 on training; finite>0 required
math.z: sum20 residual logs / (entry_training_sigma*sqrt20); not a cointegration or Gaussian claim
math.entry_fit: Freeze beta/intercept/sigma/fit start/end/entry dislocation and normalized barbell weights through exit
math.age: At signal position i, age=i-(entry_signal_position+1). At age>=19 signal exit for i+1, giving20held close-to-close intervals
math.exit_priority: max_hold first, then invalid_active_features, then zero_crossing
math.holdings: Barbell weights drift between actual target-change events; no daily reset

records.identity: This is the existing risk_off_test_20261005 monthly-loss rule itself; not a new trend/risk-off family or validation.

rule.numerator: BTCUSDT final UTC calendar-day CLOSE of immediately preceding complete month
rule.denominator: first UTC calendar-day OPEN of same complete month
rule.cadence: third UTC calendar day nominal dailyOPEN at00:00UTC
rule.persistence: prior target between decisions; no intramonthstop/filter/reentry/annualreset
rule.missing: missing/duplicate/nonfinite/incoherent required field stops dependent episode; preserve gaps, no substitute or outcome-baseddrop

execution.receiving_fee: Buy fee deducted from receivedBTC; sell fee from receivedUSDT
execution.dust: floor executablelots; retain all unsellableownedBTCdust and residualUSDT; cash target does not eraseunits
execution.capacity: Each final order AND same-account/day/asset/side sum<=0.0001*mean actualquotevolume D-8..D-2 inclusive; no capacity-drivenresize/split/retry
execution.continuedBTC: keep existingnetunits; use fundedcash only, no fee-fundedfullsell/rebuy

records.capital: 1000USDT per wholeaccount; initialstandalone1000 or portfolio750core/250other. USDT notUSD/risk-free/insuredcash. No actualaccount connection.
records.portfolio: At scheduled third-day afterinitial entry, use STOREDactualprior-month-end core/totalNAV snapshot. Net signedcore→other transfer=coreNAV−.75totalNAV. Fund payer by ownedlot sales including originalauditedceil/floorrepair, transferactualUSDT, receivercorebuys onlytransferredcash, state/mixsleeveapplies scheduledtarget afterward. Aggregatefunding+targetorders; no arithmeticreturnblend.

prospective_criteria.owner_sources: Only separately rootreleased lawful originalspotdaily observation JSONpackets; no network/auth/request/API/account/order. Inputpackets must identify source/usebasis and actual observation/available/recorded clocks. Reportedclocks are not independentPITcertification.
prospective_criteria.signal_inputs: Everydate of completepriorBTCmonth with nominalOHLC/timestamps/quotevolume and known_at_utc<=decision00UTC; preserve exact firstOPEN/finalCLOSE and ≥48h month-endclock.
prospective_criteria.capacity_inputs: All D-8..D-2 BTCquotevolumebars knownbydecision; sourcevolume positive actualfields, not currentday or D-1.
prospective_criteria.execution_reference: BTC nominal third-day first-trade OPEN, reported observed and known clocks from 00:00 UTC through 00:05 UTC; model invocation must also occur within that interval and after the reference is known. Full modeled fill and OPEN sizing are assumptions; no actual order/fill.
prospective_criteria.availability_failure: Late/missing required signal/capacity/reference or late/early model entry stops the dependent episode with immutable failure receipt. No retrospective presumed fill. Missing monthly decision prevents subsequent marks; daily mark gaps remain explicit.
prospective_criteria.mark_inputs: ObservedBTCdailyCLOSE/time, knownaftercompletedday; markmodepricesownedunits/cash and captures immutablemonth-end wallet+NAVsnapshot. Missingdaily mark is explicit coveragegap, neverzero/fabricatedreturn. Mark gapsdo not inventmonthlytiming.
prospective_criteria.snapshots: Noninitialdecisionrequiresprior-month-end snapshot previouslyrecorded beforedecision with walletunits/cash unchanged sinceitscapture. No reconstructingoldNAVfrom altered currentunits.
prospective_criteria.paper_eligibility: Exploratory/offlinepaper model may proceed with declaredfees/fills/currentvintage/custody residualuncertainty; operationalsuccess is fidelity/accounting, notfinancialproof.
prospective_criteria.state_chronology: A decision cannot consume a same-day/future marked state. Every mark requires the latest scheduled monthly decision; duplicate marks, altered snapshot wallet units/cash, missing snapshot, or snapshot recorded after decision stop the episode.

records.historical_status: Frozen original return and exceptional-stability screens failed. Reassessment can separately permit exploratory/paper study with documented uncertainty; no old screen is relabeled.

definition_provenance: Embedded original economic definitions are immutable provenance, including their original date and pre-run clauses. The separately registered Nov2 window governs current relationship dates; the original Oct8 observer remains preserved and unstarted. BTC dates are unchanged.
